title: Activity's first load takes ~16 s; drum one-shot cards are blank
description: Measured in prod: 20 concurrent Cognito identity calls at start (every signed URL fetched its own credentials; the landing page's player probed its sounds on every page) took 4-6 s, then Activity waited on the full score and sample lists (a curator's score list loads the whole library index). One-shots have no beats, so their envelope was empty.
